scope.method: Read the complete initial engine and CLI, then the final engine including the separately reread execution section, final CLI and complete runbook; compare against amended contract. Check the local-paper ignore entry. No market inputs or strategies executed.
scope.claim: No remaining static contract inconsistency identified in the reviewed bounded preparation scope. This is not a proof of absence of defects or a deployment approval.

resolved_review_points: Template metadata remains deliberately incomplete; null standard_deliverable does not preassert reviewed option deliverables.
Expiration date is explicit and consistent with the supplied last-tradable cutoff; no exchange-calendar verification is claimed.
Evidence level is local_input_simulation, not vendor-authenticated prospective trading or a broker fill.
Inclusive max_debit and retained exit reserves prevent double reservation; liquidation NAV does not subtract the same fee reserve twice.
A separate INTENT_READY transaction supplies the causal boundary after durable intent; quotes must follow that marker.
Known payload-byte hashes cannot be reused as new observations. New attributable bad-quality quotes invalidate older good marks.
Nested existing books and unsafe storage paths are refused; source, host and path fingerprints bind mutation.
Engine storage failures are wrapped with controlled class names; reviewed CLI diagnostics and validation messages do not echo raw malformed input values.
Same-engine replay is described as deterministic rather than independent arithmetic.
The runbook distinguishes templates and artificial tests from activated accounts or trading performance.
explicit_limits: No strategy adapter, price collector, schedule, broker connection or active experiment is provided.
Source IDs, hashes, definitions and timestamps are operator-supplied claims; the engine does not inspect raw source bytes or authenticate a provider.
Settlement is unimplemented. All sale proceeds remain restricted, so normal portfolio rotation is not established.
General failed fills and malformed requests are not recorded as rejection events. There is no complete durable command-attempt audit.
Corporate actions, dividends, sessions, halts, option adjustment, exercise, assignment, settlement and lifecycle resolution remain unavailable.
Long options only excludes the previously researched debit-spread strategy.
A zero or negative modeled net liquidation amount is refused and marked unknown; funded fee-paying disposal is not implemented.
The hash chain and replay do not authenticate an externally retained head or prevent a privileged rewrite or tail removal.
Quotes and fills assume displayed-side liquidity and fixed slippage; they are not obtained market executions.
Independent tests, full-project validation, Git publication and portable archive verification are owned and recorded separately.
